name: school-erp-desktop
description: SchoolERP Desktop Edition - Dual-Mode Offline & Cloud Support

scripts.build:electron: node -e "const f=require('fs'); if(f.existsSync('../node_modules/.prisma')) f.cpSync('../node_modules/.prisma', './node_modules/.prisma', {recursive:true,dereference:true}); if(f.existsSync('../node_modules/@prisma')) f.cpSync('../node_modules/@prisma', './node_modules/@prisma', {recursive:true,dereference:true});" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('electron/splash.html', 'dist/desktop/electron/splash.html')"
scripts.dist: npm run build:electron && npm run build:seed && electron-builder --config installer/builder.json
